item.title: Clocks to spring forward this weekend for daylight saving time
item.description: JACKSON, Wyo. — Folks will lose an hour of sleep this weekend as daylight saving time begins. The clock will move forward by one hour at 2 a.m. on Sunday, March 8. Under federal law, daylight saving time is observed between the second Sunday of March and the first Sunday of November.
